summary: Spot math in daily life and use counting, sorting, matching and math words to solve problems.
Count to 20, count up to 10 things, name and start writing 0 to 10, and say which group has more.
Act out adding and taking away with objects, build and split numbers to 10, and solve story problems.
Name, sort and describe flat and solid shapes, split shapes into parts, and say where things are.
Sort things, compare and order them by size or weight, continue patterns and make simple charts.
